#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

void generate(vector<int>& seq, int start, int a, int b) {
    int mod = a + b;
    int i = start;
    while (i < (int)seq.size()) {
        if (i % mod < a) {
            unordered_set<int> used;
            // add previous a elements
            for (int k = i - 1; i - k <= a; --k) {
                used.insert(seq[k]);
            }
            // fill remaining positions in this a-block
            for (int j = 0; i % mod != a && i < (int)seq.size(); i++, j++) {
                while (used.count(j)) j++;
                used.insert(j);
                seq[i] = j;
            }
        } else {
            seq[i] = seq[i-1];
            i++;
        }
    }
}

int uniqueCount(const vector<int>& seq, int from, int to) {
    unordered_set<int> used;
    for (int i = from; i < to; ++i) {
        used.insert(seq[i]);
    }
    return used.size();
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    l--; // subtract 1 to make it 0-indexed left bound
    int mod = a + b;
    int shift = l / mod * mod;
    l -= shift;
    r -= shift;
    if (r > mod * 3) {
        r = r % mod + mod * 3;
    }
    vector<int> seq(r);
    for (int i = 0; i < r; ++i) seq[i] = i;
    generate(seq, a, a, b);
    int answer = uniqueCount(seq, l, r);
    for (int i = a; i < a + b && i < r && b < r; ++i) {
        seq[i] = seq[b];
    }
    generate(seq, a + b, a, b);
    answer = min(answer, uniqueCount(seq, l, r));
    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
